aiResearchSummary.text: SafeBeat Rx is engaged in developing a system for remote drug monitoring and titration, as described in the title and abstract, which details an apparatus, computer program product, and method for providing corrected QT interval (QTc) measurements from electrocardiographic data. This involves receiving and cleansing ECG data from at least one source, supporting cardiac therapeutic management via software accessible from a phone. Their research and development focus on remote cardiac monitoring and drug titration technologies.

insights.title: Hybrid therapeutic platform
insights.statement: SafeBeat Rx combines AI-based ECG Analysis and Drug Dosing Software with SafeBeat Platform.
insights.implication: The company is positioned as a biotechnology platform with both a physical therapeutic-delivery modality and an AI-assisted discovery layer, rather than as a standalone AI software vendor.
caveats: Product descriptions are profile claims and do not establish clinical efficacy.
